# Lantern Oil

## Overview

Light is tracked by the flask, not by the hour.

## Mechanics

One flask per night in [[The Long Marsh]], two if anything goes wrong.

## Design Philosophy

Losing the light should be a decision somebody made, not a number that ran out while
nobody was looking.

## Related Rules

- [[Poles and Depth]]

## Related Locations

- [[The Long Marsh]]

## Notes

Cost the crew a lantern in Session 3 and nearly a second in Session 4.
